title: PTPGE ucp-manifest/1
description: How a storefront carries the PTPGE identity in its Universal Commerce Protocol manifest (https://<domain>/.well-known/ucp). This schema validates the PTPGE parts of that manifest, not UCP itself: the capability entry for the published extension org.ptpge.print.identity, and a `ptpge` block that names the printer's register identity, where its vendor declaration lives, the vocabulary and the fingerprint resolver. On a checkout line the identity is the ptpge-cfs/1 fingerprint (see https://ptpge.org/ucp/schemas/identity.json). Everything else in the manifest is UCP's and is left open. Licence of the schema: CC BY 4.0.

version.description: The UCP protocol version the manifest follows.

identityCapability.description: The extension as UCP expects a capability to be declared: version, spec page, schema, and what it extends.

version.description: The extension version — the date on https://ptpge.org/ucp/identity.

ptpgeBlock.description: Where an agent goes next: the printer's register identity, its own declaration (capability and offerings — never duplicated in the manifest), the vocabulary the identity is computed over, and the resolver.

declaration.description: The printer's vendor-declaration/1 at its known path on the same domain as this manifest.

request.description: Optional: where a request/1 may be POSTed outside UCP checkout (an implementation's endpoint).

lineItemIdentity.$comment: Mirror of https://ptpge.org/ucp/schemas/identity.json#/$defs/ptpge_identity — the object a checkout line item carries under `item.ptpge`.
